detail: Use one authenticated metadata source: after exact CI/source/ID/digest checks, artifact helper writes public source-run/artifact IDs to GITHUB_ENV; download action consumes those exact values. Test relay with mocked authenticated metadata and verify workflow has no stale IDs before publication. Source CI remains exact green ea468 and is reused without redispatch.
